item.title: Arjun Arora
item.dc:creator: Admin
item.content:encoded: Arjun is a Yoga practitioner, musician and digital consultant who's been learning, practising and teaching Yoga along with his wife, Saja in their Yoga studio in Beirut. He has worked with various startups and organizations in the digital design and marketing space after graduating from IIT Madras. Sarveda was born out of a passion for Yoga, alternative health, ancient philosophies and music, combined with an experience in the digital world.

item.title: Saja Ammar Arora
item.dc:creator: Admin
item.content:encoded: Saja is a hatha yoga teacher at Shakti which she runs along with Arjun. She learnt her practice from the Sivananda Ashram, Madurai. An avid traveller, she has travelled extensively across India and various parts of south-east Asia to learn meditation, Ayurveda, Kalaripayyatu and music. She also works with children and organizes yoga retreats in Lebanon and across the eastern parts of the world.

item.title: Kumar Anurag
item.dc:creator: Admin
item.content:encoded: Anurag is initiated into kriya yoga Sadhana from Giri sampradaya. He has done his B.Tech in Civil Eng. from IIT Bombay and is currently helping Sarveda for content, marketing and strategy

item.title: Dr Swati Ramamurty
item.dc:creator: Admin
item.content:encoded: Dr Swathi is Sarveda's Ayurvedic consultant who always has natural remedies for all kinds of imbalances. As a Senior Research Fellow at The Central Ayurveda Research Institute, she has designed various Ayurvedic formulations out in the world today. Swati is a trained classical dancer and an avid believer in yogic practices.

item.title: Vishakha Gujar
item.dc:creator: Admin
item.content:encoded: A final year medical student, Vishakha is pursuing Bachelors in Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery from Pune, India. Apart from writing insightful content on Ayurveda, she also is a Yoga enthusiast. Her interests also lie in studying psychology and public health. A determined smile seeker and tech junkie, she believes in living mindfully and being present in the moment.

item.title: Raymar Sotomayor
item.dc:creator: Admin
item.content:encoded: Raymar is a Venezuelan living in France who enjoys designing, cooking and practicing her Yoga asanas. She has been practicing Yoga for the past 7 years and enjoys cooking vegetarian food! She truly loves being in nature and travelling to explore and experience different cultures around the world. With all these different interests and experiences, Raymar is able to uniquely brings out creatives for Sarveda.

item.title: Gaurav Sashittal
item.dc:creator: Admin
item.content:encoded: Gaurav serves as a managing editor at Sarveda. Apart from being an avid reader and a bit of a grammar nazi, Gaurav also plays the guitar and loves to sing. He is a polyglot and is constantly in pursuit of learning new languages. In the past decade, he has consulted as a writer, editor and content strategist for many digital brands and startups. He also previously taught undergraduate English literature at Jain University and Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan. His interests also include travelling, watching movies, cooking and reading. Gaurav has a master's degree in English Studies from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras.

item.title: Minin D'Souza
item.dc:creator: Admin
item.content:encoded: Minin hails from the Northern part of Karnataka in India. Having been raised near the sea, Minin likes spending most of his time along the coast biking, walking or swimming. His meticulous sense of design and programming helps Sarveda quickly and efficiently execute new ideas.

item.title: Shridhar Gunjahalli
item.dc:creator: Admin
item.content:encoded: The backend developer is the spine for any digital organization as so is Shridhar for Sarveda. He ensures that everything on Sarveda not just looks good but works how it should! He is a WordPress enthusiast who loves music and cricket.
